According to the observations at 18:30 hrs MST today, the Deep Depression over North Andaman Sea and adjoining Mottama, Mon-Taninthayi Coastal has moved North-Northwestwards and is crossing from the south of Kyaikto, Mon State, near the mouth of the Sittaung River in Myanmar. It is centered at about 35 Nautical miles East-Northeast of Thongwa, 35 Nautical miles East-Southeast of Bago and 90 Nautical miles South-Southeast of Phyu, Myanmar.Monsoon is strong to Vigorous over the Andaman Sea and South Bay of Bengal and moderate elsewhere over the Bay of Bengal. Weather is a few cloud over the Westcentral Bay, Southwest Bay of Bengal and partly cloudy to cloudy over the Andaman Sea and elsewhere over the Bay of Bengal.

Top Announcement

 According to the observations at 15:30 hrs MST today, the Depression over North Andaman Sea and adjoining Mottama, Mon-Taninthayi Coastal has moved North-Northwestwards and further intensified into a Deep Depression. It is centered at about 20 Nautical miles West-Southwest of Mawlamyine, 70 Nautical miles East-Southeast of Thongwa and 75 Nautical miles Southeast of Bago, Myanmar. Monsoon is strong to Vigorous over the Andaman Sea and South Bay of Bengal and weak to moderate elsewhere over the Bay of Bengal.
